description: Calculates the FHA upfront and annual mortgage insurance premium (rates, dollar amounts, first-year monthly premium and how long the annual premium lasts) from the base loan amount, loan-to-value ratio, term and the case number date, using the HUD rate schedule in force for that date. Cites the Mortgagee Letter and HUD Handbook 4000.1 Appendix 1.0. Pure calculation: an estimate, not a loan approval.

base_loan_amount.description: Base loan amount in dollars, before any financed upfront premium.
base_loan_amount.title: Base Loan Amount

case_number_date.description: Date the FHA case number was assigned, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (UTC).
case_number_date.title: Case Number Date

endorsement_date.description: Date FHA endorsed (or will endorse) the loan, YYYY-MM-DD, when known; it selects the 2023 rates for case numbers assigned before 2023-03-20.
endorsement_date.title: Endorsement Date

interest_rate.description: Note rate as an annual percent, e.g. 6.25; gives the first-year premium on the average scheduled balance.
interest_rate.title: Interest Rate

ltv.description: Loan-to-value ratio as a percent, e.g. 96.5: base loan amount divided by the lesser of price and appraised value.
ltv.title: Ltv

refinances_loan_endorsed_before_june_200.description: True for a Streamline or Simple Refinance of an FHA loan endorsed on or before May 31, 2009. Default false.
refinances_loan_endorsed_before_june_200.title: Refinances Loan Endorsed Before June 2009

term_months.description: Loan term in months, e.g. 360 for 30 years or 180 for 15 years. Default 360.
term_months.title: Term Months

name: calculate_fha_mip
title: Calculate FHA mortgage insurance premium
